name: Schedule or send an email campaign
description: Schedule or send a completed draft. Irreversible once emails go out: always confirm audience and content with the user first.

ui_steps: Open the draft in Marketing > Campaigns.
Confirm Sender, Recipients, Subject and Design all show a green check.
Click 'Schedule' and choose a time or send now.

verification.notes: Option seen in the UI menu. Not executed. Deliberately not executed: it would send real email, and the account shows a marketing-email suspension banner.

side_effects: Sends email to the selected recipients and consumes plan quota.
